extraction.text:
GAURAV KUMAR

Software Development (AI/ ML) | Data Science | Generative AI |

Dynamic and results-oriented Software Developer specializing in AI/ML technologies, with a focus on developing innovative solutions and scalable applications. Targeting roles in Software Development, Data Science, and AI Engineering.

PROFILE SUMMARY

A competent professional with over 4 years of experience in Software Development, with a particular emphasis on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, showcasing proficiency in managing comprehensive Software Development Life Cycles from inception to deployment.

Presently working as Software Developer at Ksolves India Ltd., orchestrating integration of sophisticated AI solutions into various projects while actively engaging in development activities that require both leadership and technical expertise.

Expertise in managing complete SDLC including design, development, enhancements, customization, requirement gathering & analysis, testing, coding.

Rich experience in supporting development & maintenance of multiple applications; actively contributed in various phases of development right from requirement analysis, implementation, deployment.

Rich project management experience; led the project execution in tune with the business objectives; reviewed functional requirements and translated the same into technical specifications.

Capable of developing effective solutions for real-time problems by utilizing

Generative AI and Machine Learning technologies.

Client-centric professional with excellence in understanding clients’ requirements and designing a roadmap for further product development.

Top performing team player & quick learner with capabilities in rendering technical guidance to the team members at all levels across the organization.

 WORK EXPERIENCE

Ksolves India Ltd., Pune	Since Sept’20

Software Developer

Key Result Areas:

Integrating a Large Language Model (LLM) with intelligent agents to assist technicians in diagnosing device impairments and implementing effective solutions.

Collaborating with Nokia on multiple Generative AI use cases, focusing on Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and successfully delivering proofs of concept (POCs) and production-grade applications.

Developing an in-house AI-powered Knowledge Management System, harnessing Generative AI and RAG to enhance organizational knowledge sharing and accessibility.

Collaborating with stakeholders across all phases of the project lifecycle, from initiation to successful delivery.

Spearheading software development lifecycle, right from requirement gathering & analysis, documentation (functional specifications, technical design), coding and testing.

Defining design, architecture and other technology directions for implementation.

Leading design & architectural assignments, and taking critical decisions on the direction of products and design & development of critical modules.

Executing code delivery by integrating multiple systems and middleware, completing rigorous unit, functional, and technical testing.

+91-9123439557

gaurav.py1998@gmail.com

Gaurav_Kumar

CORE COMPETENCIES

 EDUCATION

 B.Tech. in CSE with 9.19 CGPA, from Rajiv Gandhi Technical University, Bhopal in 2021

 TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Python, JavaScript

AI/ML: Scikit-Learn, Keras, Tensorflow, Langchain, ONNX, HugginfaceHub, FAISS, Agentic AI Pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib, Seaborn

Databases: PostgreSQL, Cassandra, MySQL

Back-End & Cloud: Flask, Odoo, FastAPI, Git/ GitHub, SQLAlchemy, PyArmor, PyTest, Jenkins, Docker, AWS EC2, AWS S3, AWS Sagemaker

 CERTIFICATIONS

Certification in Python for Data Science Specialization from IIT Madras.



Highlights:

Designed and led the development of a Flask-based Microservice that leveraged unsupervised machine learning to cluster fault devices based on their characteristics, proactively assigned them to technicians, and reduced device failure incidents by 38%.

Optimized E-Commerce operations for 100+ clients by developing a WooCommerce-Odoo connector, thus minimized manual data errors by 40%.

 PROJECTS MANAGED

Title: Proactive Network Management

Description: A web-based application that intelligently clusters underperforming routers based on impairment patterns, assigns technicians for resolution, and leverages Generative AI to provide optimal troubleshooting solutions.

Responsibilities:

Architected a high-performance application leveraging Flask, Scikit-Learn, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL to streamline network monitoring and fault detection.

Optimized clustering algorithms by integrating advanced feature engineering and refining data retrieval mechanisms, enhancing fault detection accuracy and improving model precision by 9%.

Title: Case Closure Generators

Description: An automated solution that processes email exchanges and helpdesk reports, categorizing and summarizing key insights for seamless integration into Microsoft Power Apps.

Responsibilities:

Designed and implemented both proof-of-concept (POC) and production-ready applications to extract and process Salesforce data from REST APIs and email exchanges.

Engineered a large language model (LLM)-powered solution for automated Case Closure report generation, ensuring seamless integration with Microsoft Power Apps.

Title: Troubleshooting Next Best Steps

Description: A predictive analytics application utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to analyze current issues, retrieve similar past scenarios, and recommend the most effective next steps for troubleshooting.

Responsibilities:

Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to convert historical troubleshooting steps into vector embedding, stored within Elasticsearch.

Leveraged LLMs to analyze stored vectors and dynamically recommend the most effective troubleshooting steps, optimizing resolution efficiency in future processes.

Title: Odoo WooCommerce Connector

Description: A real-time synchronization tool that seamlessly integrates WooCommerce with Odoo, ensuring automated, bidirectional data flow for enhanced operational efficiency.

Responsibilities:

Constructed a real-time connector module in Odoo, enabling seamless data exchange and synchronization between Odoo models and WooCommerce domains.

Implemented webhook-driven automation to ensure accurate and efficient data processing across both platforms.

 REWARDS & RECOGNITIONS

Achieved "Star Performer" recognition 3 times at Ksolves India Ltd. for delivering exceptional development solutions and driving technical excellence.

Honored with "Going Above & Beyond" Award for architecting a high-performance, scalable WooCommerce connector, thus enhanced system efficiency & integration capabilities.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS MANAGED
Title: Proactive Network Management
Description: A web-based application that intelligently clusters underperforming routers based on impairment patterns, assigns technicians for resolution, and leverages Generative AI to provide optimal troubleshooting solutions.
Responsibilities:
Architected a high-performance application leveraging Flask, Scikit-Learn, Cassandra, and PostgreSQL to streamline network monitoring and fault detection.
Optimized clustering algorithms by integrating advanced feature engineering and refining data retrieval mechanisms, enhancing fault detection accuracy and improving model precision by 9%.
Title: Case Closure Generators
Description: An automated solution that processes email exchanges and helpdesk reports, categorizing and summarizing key insights for seamless integration into Microsoft Power Apps.
Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented both proof-of-concept (POC) and production-ready applications to extract and process Salesforce data from REST APIs and email exchanges.
Engineered a large language model (LLM)-powered solution for automated Case Closure report generation, ensuring seamless integration with Microsoft Power Apps.
Title: Troubleshooting Next Best Steps
Description: A predictive analytics application utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to analyze current issues, retrieve similar past scenarios, and recommend the most effective next steps for troubleshooting.
Responsibilities:
Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to convert historical troubleshooting steps into vector embedding, stored within Elasticsearch.
Leveraged LLMs to analyze stored vectors and dynamically recommend the most effective troubleshooting steps, optimizing resolution efficiency in future processes.
Title: Odoo WooCommerce Connector
Description: A real-time synchronization tool that seamlessly integrates WooCommerce with Odoo, ensuring automated, bidirectional data flow for enhanced operational efficiency.
Responsibilities:
Constructed a real-time connector module in Odoo, enabling seamless data exchange and synchronization between Odoo models and WooCommerce domains.
Implemented webhook-driven automation to ensure accurate and efficient data processing across both platforms.
